topics.title_zh: 标榜AI提速教学私校被曝近半学生数学脱靶
topics.title_en: A look at Alpha School, a network of private schools that claims to teach kids 2x as fast using AI; data shows ~50% of K-8 students missed this goal in math (Dana Goldstein/New York Times)
topics.summary_zh: 号称凭借AI能让孩子学习提速两倍的私立学校网络被揭露真实学业数据，近半数学生数学成绩未能达标
topics.summary_en: Alpha School, an innovative private school network expanding aggressively into public education, has consistently claimed its proprietary AI-driven curriculum enables children to learn twice as fast. However, newly revealed internal performance data reveals that nearly 50% of its K-8 students failed to meet this two-times acceleration benchmark in mathematics. The stark gap between promotional rhetoric and actual learning outcomes exposes the overhyped nature of algorithmic schooling and sparks skepticism over its real-world educational value.

perspective_pro.point_en: Extended reasoning represents a historic step in exploring mathematical conjectures, opening a new paradigm for scientific discovery.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 严谨学界 / 理论数学家

perspective_con.point_en: The submission exhibits critical logical disconnects and formal hallucinations, failing to satisfy the rigorous standards of mathematical proof.

topics.title_en: Ex-Google CEO Eric Schmidt calls OpenAI and Anthropic modern colonial trading companies
topics.summary_zh: 在《外交事务》中，历史学家尼尔·弗格森、研究员丽莎·克拉森和谷歌前首席执行官埃里克·施密特将美国和中国视为人工智能帝国，将其他国家视为附属国。比赛的胜负不是由突破决定的，而是由谁能够为其提供资金决定的。仅美国企业就计划在 202 年支出超过 6000 亿美元
topics.summary_en: In Foreign Affairs, historian Niall Ferguson, researcher Lisa Klaassen, and former Google CEO Eric Schmidt cast the US and China as AI empires and every other country as a dependency. The race won't be decided by breakthroughs but by who can bankroll it. US corporations alone plan to spend more than $600 billion in 2026. topics.summary_zh: 英伟达开源Flora数据引擎，通过Qwen模型优化，将机器人视频标注成本从GPT-6 Astra的88美元降至0.72美元
